Role Title: Video Annotation

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Video Annotation experts to contribute to a dynamic customer project focused on high-impact data labeling. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Carefully review and annotate video content based on detailed guidelines and rubrics provided for the project.
  2. Apply consistent tagging, labeling, or classification to video segments, ensuring high precision and adherence to annotation standards.
  3. Document and communicate annotation decisions effectively through written and verbal channels.
  4. Utilize annotation tools or platforms, adapting quickly to new interfaces as required by the customer.
  5. Collaborate with project leads or quality assurance professionals to clarify requirements and refine outputs.
  6. Submit annotations within agreed-upon milestones, maintaining a focus on accuracy and completeness.
  7. Provide feedback on guidelines or processes to enhance annotation quality and efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience with video annotation and a strong understanding of annotation rubrics.
  2. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on clarity and detail orientation.
  3. Ability to follow detailed instructions and adapt quickly to evolving project requirements.
  4. Experience working on data annotation, labeling, or similar projects — generalists with relevant experience are welcome.
  5. Proficiency with digital annotation tools or related software (no video editing experience needed).
  6. Proactive in seeking clarification and providing constructive feedback on processes.
  7. Commitment to delivering high-quality, accurate annotations within project timelines.
